ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 98:2 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark/black pigmentation field; singular high-contrast white vertical linear mark on the left lobe; scattered white punctate clusters located in the lower-central region and on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending into the central fluke junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated profile with high-frequency variations; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude ranges from 4 to 12 pixels, with maximum density observed on the distal margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric curve characterized by initial concavity at the notch transitioning to a convex sweep terminating in highly acute, recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial clusters of white circular pixel groups observed primarily on the distal trailing edges and in sparse groupings on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of a prominent vertical high-contrast linear streak on the left lobe and multiple smaller diagonal linear disruptions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major vertical linear scar on the left lobe; multiple punctate white scars across the central body of both lobes; visible irregularities in trailing edge topography consistent with historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely pointed and hooked distal tips with concentrated white pixel highlights.
